content.comment_body: Hello all, I'm seeking advice on how to wire the S0 input from an electricity meter to a [product_name] for monitoring energy consumption using its fast digital input. My hardware: [product_name] ([article_no]) Electricity meter: SDM 120DB MID ([url]) According to the electricity meter's wiring diagram (see [url]), there are two S0 pulse outputs (terminals 6 and 7), but only one input on the [product_name] is available. Should both outputs be connected to a single [product_name] input, or is that incorrect? Thanks for your help. Best regards, [user_name] PS. I have checked all available instructions but couldn't find useful details.
Connect terminal 7 (+) of the meter to a DC supply (5–27V), same as the [product_name] CPU L+. Attach terminal 6 (-) to one of the fast counter inputs, I3 to I6, and that will suffice. [user_name]
Thanks, that clarifies it for me. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discussed exact wiring between an SDM 120DB MID electricity meter and the fast digital input of a [product_name] (version 8) for monitoring energy usage. The main user required practical wiring instructions beyond what was provided in the available manuals, which highlighted a need for more accessible integration information for connecting external meters to [company_name] modules.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for clear, step-by-step wiring instructions to connect the S0 outputs of the electricity meter to the [product_name], wanting practical advice when official documentation does not fully address specific scenarios.
